newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-UBS ups Telmex earnings views.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-UBS ups Telmex earnings views.

text.p: --UBS Securities said it raised its earnings estimates for Mexican blue chip Telmex but kept its hold rating on the stock.
--The firm, citing the peso's strength, increased Telmex's earnings estimates to $3.84 from $3.17 per ADR for 1996 and to $2.84 from $2.72 for 1997.
--It also adjusted its 1998 earnings view to $3.44 from $3.46 per ADR.

--"The stock is expensive on our 1997 forecast, but it looks attractive on 1998 and beyond. We believe it is too early to raise our rating," UBS said, adding that it continues to believe next year will be difficult for Telmex.
